text:
maria: Quick kickoff — LyraEdge case study + webinar. Need interview transcript, final quote approval from customer, legal signoff, and a landing page hero. Target publish + webinar: next Fri. Who's owning assets + timeline? @chris?
chris: I'll own production + landing. Can we confirm interview recording time? prefer Tue morning.
sana: I have the raw video, can clean and pull 60s clip. Need final quote text by Wed EOD.
kevin: Looping in legal_bot — can you run NDAs/quote approvals? Also cc @elaine for PR approvals.
legal_bot: FYI: Send final quote with attribution line and full customer name. We require a signed release for the webinar. I'll queue review — expected turnaround 48h.
elaine: PR review: want a customer-approved one-liner and 3 bullets of impact. Also can we get a case metric verified (cost reduction %)?
maria: Customer said 28% avg latency reduction. I'll ask them to confirm exact phrasing. Also need to route webinar signups to SDR queue. @sdr_oncall can you confirm tracking?
sdr_oncall: Yep — we'll set up the form to push to HubSpot; add utm=lyra_cs. Assign to inbound SDR rotation. Need final landing URL and speaker list.
chris: Speakers: Maria (PM), Jonah (LyraEdge CSM), and me demoing. Will share draft slides by Thu.
sana: Transcript note: we recorded with captions disabled; I'll run the audio through ASR and send a cleaned transcript by Wed noon.
kevin: Legal follow-ups: customer wants to edit one sentence re numbers. They asked for 'up to 28%'. We'll approve if it's accurately attributed. Send me the revised quote.
maria: I'll get the customer's edited quote today. If legal approves by Thu, we'll lock copy and schedule the webinar for Friday 11am PT. :crossed_fingers:
elaine: Can someone add a short customer blurb for the press list? 30-40 words max.
maria: Putting a draft here: 'LyraEdge reduced inference latency by up to 28% while maintaining peak throughput, saving engineering time and cloud costs.' Thoughts?
chris: Looks good. Minor suggestion: replace 'cloud costs' with 'operational costs' — broader.
sana: Added to transcript doc: link https://redwood.work/drive/lyraedge-transcript (internal).
legal_bot: Reminder: please attach signed release to this thread when available. I'll mark review complete once attached.
sdr_oncall: Form & automation will be ready Friday morning. Please confirm final landing slug.
maria: Final slug: /customers/lyraedge. I'll post final assets to the channel and ping sales ops when live. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
